general.notes: Module is Tx1550/Rx1310 bi-directional on single fiber (title). Ordering row for L9-FC553101-60CTC lists working temperature -10~70℃; Features list Standard 0 to +70°C and Industrial -40°C to +85°C; Recommended Operating Conditions give TC 0–70°C and TI -40–85°C. Operating data rate stated as 155.52 Mbps (Recommended Operating Conditions) and up to 155Mbps (Features); ordering rate 155Mb/s. Launch power and sensitivity rows note 60km. Transmitter central wavelength table includes 1270–1310–1350 (note 1310FP) and 1510–1550–1590 (note 1550FP); ordering specifies 1550nm DFB for this part. Supply current Icc max 250 mA at 3.3 V (no power in W stated). Signal detect outputs (LV)TTL per pin description.
general.suggestions: Clarify whether bit_rate_gbps should store Mbps literals (155.52) or converted Gbps. Add 1×9 / bi-di form factors to enum if common. Map Signal Detect Range explicitly to LOS assert/deassert if that is vendor intent.
